findings.evidence:
- Cleanup trigger moved off the ingest availability check: `pkg/ddl/ingest/backend_mgr.go:100` now only runs `diskRoot.PreCheckUsage()`; first-parent version previously ran cleanup first (`pkg/ddl/ingest/backend_mgr.go:105` in first parent had `m.cleanupSortPath(ctx)`).
- New cleanup loop runs on a 1-minute ticker with no initial run: `pkg/ddl/ddl.go:891`.
- Disk check failure returns `ErrIngestCheckEnvFailed` when available disk <10%: `pkg/ddl/ingest/disk_root.go:118`.
- That error path can cancel add-index at StateNone: `pkg/ddl/index.go:693` cancels when `!errorIsRetryable`, and `pkg/ddl/index.go:1011` only treats a narrow set of `*terror.Error` codes as retryable.
findings.fix:
Run one cleanup iteration immediately before starting the ticker loop (or right after env init) so stale dirs don’t survive long enough to trip `PreCheckUsage()`.
Optional hardening: on `PreCheckUsage()` failure caused by stale-dir bloat, consider falling back to txn-merge instead of cancelling (if semantics allow).
findings.impact: On nodes where stale ingest temp dirs consume significant disk (e.g., after crash / large ingest backfill), a fast add-index job can be cancelled if it hits the disk pre-check before the next 1-minute cleanup tick, even though cleanup could have freed space shortly. This is a user-visible DDL availability regression (spurious job cancellations/retries) tied to timing/concurrency.
findings.later_fix_evidence: Checked `upstream/master` (f0813a3696): cleanup is still ticker-based with no immediate run (`upstream/master:pkg/ddl/ddl.go` contains `CleanUpTempDirLoop` with a 1-minute ticker), and add-index backfill selection still performs a disk `PreCheckUsage()` without any synchronous temp-dir cleanup beforehand (`upstream/master:pkg/ddl/index.go` `pickBackfillType`).
findings.verify:
- Create a large stale job subdir under the ingest temp root (`${temp-dir}/tmp_ddl-{port}`) so free space drops below the 10% threshold, then start a fast add-index job shortly after TiDB start (or shortly after a previous ingest job completes).
- Expected after fix: cleanup runs before disk pre-check, preventing a spurious `ErrIngestCheckEnvFailed` cancellation when stale dirs are the primary cause of low disk; job should proceed (or at least not be cancelled before cleanup has a chance to run).
findings.what: Potential regression: stale ingest temp dirs are no longer cleaned just-in-time before the ingest disk pre-check, because cleanup moved to a background loop that first runs only after a 1-minute tick. This creates a window where `PreCheckUsage()` can fail due to stale-dir disk bloat and the add-index job can be cancelled (non-retryable) even though the new cleanup loop would have freed space soon.

subject: ddl: clean ingest temp data dir in background loop (#54008)
summary: This commit moves ingest temp-dir cleanup out of `litBackendCtxMgr.CheckMoreTasksAvailable` and into a periodic DDL background loop (`CleanUpTempDirLoop`) that queries `mysql.tidb_ddl_job` to decide which per-job directories are stale. `InitGlobalLightningEnv` is refactored to accept a caller-generated ingest temp root and now returns an `ok` flag.
